meaning: When the underlying event/measurement occurred or was observed.
selection_rule: Never proves public knowability by itself.
notes: Preserve source/raw timestamp separately when present.

meaning: Source-asserted publication/release time for a versioned artifact.
selection_rule: May seed first_known_at only when publication semantics are defensible.
notes: Mutable pages without version history cannot inherit a guessed historic publish time.

meaning: Timestamp reported by the upstream provider for the observation/version.
selection_rule: Requires source semantics and provenance; not automatically trusted as first public availability.
notes: Keep original value and normalized UTC value.

meaning: When this project captured/retrieved the evidence.
selection_rule: Conservative upper bound on knowability and fallback when earlier public availability cannot be defended.
notes: Distinct retrievals remain distinct even for identical bytes.

meaning: Earliest defensible time the exact information/version was publicly knowable.
selection_rule: Must be <= forecast/training feature cutoff for eligibility.
notes: Derived from evidence policy; never guessed from season labels.

meaning: Start of the real-world interval/state for which the observation applies.
selection_rule: Target/event time must lie in interval when the domain is interval-valued.
notes: Future-effective facts may be known before valid_from.

meaning: Exclusive end of the real-world interval/state for which the observation applies.
selection_rule: Target/event time must be < valid_to when present.

meaning: Point effective time for a rule/state/change when interval semantics begin at one instant.
selection_rule: Applied to target/event time, not substituted for knowledge time.
notes: Usually equivalent to valid_from for point changes.

meaning: Earliest defensible knowledge time under a named PIT policy version.
selection_rule: Cache/derived field only; query still checks target validity, domain policy, revision state and cutoff.
notes: Not a raw source timestamp and never sufficient alone.

selection_rule: Does not prove user-visible/public availability by itself.

meaning: Earliest defensible availability of the exact forecast run/product.
notes: Preferred first_known basis for issued weather runs.

meaning: Time/environment instant the weather forecast predicts.
selection_rule: Must match/cover the game target time according to domain interpolation policy.
Descriptive validity only; does not establish publication timing.

meaning: When a source game was completed for purposes of historical aggregates/labels.
selection_rule: Prior-game output cannot enter features until both game completion and source evidence knowability precede cutoff.
notes: Labels may be learned only after completion in chronological training replay.
